开场仅环境底噪：林风、远处虫鸣。闷响响起时虫鸣骤停 0.5 秒，随后缓慢恢复。 史诗级开场定调，用空间尺度建立压抑感，画面左侧留空强化森林未知感。不需要背景音乐。只保留环境声。



正面提示词（必须加入）：

Extreme close-up macro, crisp individual leaf veins, translucent foliage, backlit leaves, delicate natural structure, botanical photography, sharp edges, 8k photorealistic, high-frequency details, light scattering physics, macro lens depth of field.

负面提示词（必须拉满）：

Smudged leaves, blurry foliage, melted textures, flat painting, plastic plants, lack of detail, messy clusters, AI artifacts, deformed leaf silhouette, low resolution, out of focus foreground.
